sonnet.problem: The story card is only a bare fragment, "But the others standing there say, 'Leave Him alone.'". It has no context and none of Papa Dorin's voice. It also splits one beat across two cards, because the next choice card repeats the same quote and asks about the rest of the verse.
sonnet.rule: **Short, but not stripped down.** A story card still has enough of Papa Dorin's voice and enough context that the moment makes sense.

sonnet.problem: The right answer, "If Elijah comes to save Him", reuses Elijah as an answer. Elijah was already the right answer on card 4 and was introduced on card 5, so the baker can pick it from earlier cards without reading verse 49.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
